status: partial — terminated due to memory pressure / swap thrashing on 16 GiB host

trials.note: seed=2028 corrupted trial terminated mid-run; partial means reflect 2-of-3 paired comparisons

notes: Per-trial fine-tune time on 1.7B-bf16 was ~330-430s for 5 steps and ~2400-3000s for 25 steps -- 13x and ~60x slower than the linear-from-360M projection due to swap activity (system has 16 GiB RAM; PyTorch AdamW maintains fp32 master state alongside bf16 model weights, doubling memory pressure).
Completing the 100-step row would have required ~10 hours of wall time per trial; the 500-step row would have required ~50 hours per trial -- infeasible on this hardware.

Conclusion at this configuration: rho(1.7B, bf16, lr=5e-5) appears not larger than rho(SmolLM2-360M, fp32, lr=5e-5) in the 5-25 step regime.  Whether this represents a genuine plateau, a dtype-induced artefact, or a need for larger-step measurement remains open.
